newsitem.title: INDIA: International real estate mission to visit India.
newsitem.headline: International real estate mission to visit India.

text.p: A trade delegation of international real estate professionals will tour India for a week from Sunday to identify channels for foreign investment and new technologies that will invigorate the country's real estate industry.
The trade mission has been organised by the International Real Estate Federation (FIABCI), a non-gvernmental organisation which operates in 50 countries.
"India, being one of the most populous countries of the world, has a tremendous need for providing shelter to its masses," FIABCI's Bombay branch said in a statement.

"The ownership rate of housing is only 18 percent in India compared to 70 percent in the West," the statement added. "FIABCI India attempts to integrate these needs with global technologies, materials, investments and developments."
The delegation will include French, American, Indonesian and Malaysian real estate consultants, it said.
The members of the delegation will meet and interact with government bodies, industry chiefs and property professionals who share a common interest in developing the industry.
